title: Order Enumerations
description: Canonical business vocabularies. These are the source-of-truth meanings. Adapters (Computyme, Shopify, EDI) map their internal codes TO these values, never the reverse. Add new members over minor schema versions; never repurpose an existing member.

SourceChannel.description: Origination system / sales channel for the order.

OrderStatus.description: High-level lifecycle state of the order as a whole. Replaces legacy integer statuses (e.g. 55/56/110).

FulfillmentType.description: How a fulfillment group is sourced/shipped. Replaces legacy OrderTypeId integers.

FulfillmentStatus.description: State of an individual fulfillment group.

LineType.description: Semantic role of an order line. Formalizes bundles, freight, and promotions.
